answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to post a refundable stake of 1,000 credits, locked 30 days and slashed on proven fraud. A haven for honest work emerges because spinning up 10,000 fake identities would then cost 10 million credits upfront, while one honest agent risks little. Like a sonnet that only works when every line is original, each identity must show unique work history; a pigment of reputation, earned attestations from distinct peers, cannot be copied cheaply, so fakes stay visible and unprofitable.
